span.p:
POST /api/v1/files — no Content-Range header ⇒ direct upload
(Content-Range present ⇒ 32 MiB chunked session, same commit path)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
AuthMiddleware: X-API-Key fsc_… → app_key.lookup_hash (sha256) + bcrypt compare
then per-user rate limit + concurrency cap (Redis, fail-open)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ResolveUploadTarget: X-Virtual-Path → VFS.Resolve
face/2026/{session}/{step}-{n}.jpg ⇒ /apps/{tenant-slug}/face/2026/{session}/{step}-{n}.jpg

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
RequirePathPermission(write) · X-Visibility private|public
Content-Length required and ≤ FS_DIRECT_MAX_UPLOAD_MB (default 2048)

ShareBlobKey: wrap the existing blob key for this tenant

span.p:
⑤ Move /hot/tmp/{uuid} → /hot/blobs/ab/cd/{sha256}.{uuid}.enc
(rename inside the filer, no re-copy)

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
⑥ ONE Postgres transaction:
ensureBlob (INSERT … ON CONFLICT sha256) · blob_key · file (UPLOADING)
file_version v1 · user_file(owner, current_version 1) · ref_count+1
ReleaseHashLease · CommitQuota · event_outbox

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
co-owner branch (multi-owner model):
no new file/version — UpsertUserFile(current_version = matched version)
result CoOwned = true, quota still charged

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: blob already carries an AV verdict?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
status READY or QUARANTINED immediately
outbox file.created / file.quarantined

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
status SCANNING — not downloadable yet (D-02)
outbox file.uploading_done

span.p:
201 Created {file_id, virtual_path, status, size, etag, version, dedup_hit, visibility}
headers ETag + Location

span.p:
MirrorAsync (goroutine): decrypt → LocalFS write
{FS_MIRROR_ROOT}/{tenantId}/{appId}/apps/{slug}/face/…jpg + .blobmap pointer
runs only when FS_MIRROR_ROOT is set — no retry, no cleanup
